Scholarship overview

The Simon Anders Axelsen scholarships support PhD research through UQ's Institute for Molecular Bioscience. Applicants first submit an expression of interest and then complete the full application stage. The named call should be read separately from the Institute's general scholarship information.

Research Areas

  • Molecular bioscience
  • Biomedical research
  • Doctoral training

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryTuition covered and tax-free living stipend AUD 39,220/year at the published 2026 rate, indexed annually.

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityProgramme and project criteria apply; see official eligibility guidance
Further conditionsThis is the named Axelsen call, not the separate general UQ scholarship round; do not reuse 2023 rates.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round23 November 2026 EOI; 7 December 2026 application
LocationAustralia

About University of Queensland

UQ offers postgraduate research through its schools and institutes, including the Institute for Molecular Bioscience. Its scholarship routes include university awards, named scholarships and funding attached to specific research projects.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 23 November 2026 EOI; 7 December 2026 application. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
